sourceTitle: How Gemini is helping students and teachers in the classroom
originalTitle: How Gemini is helping students and teachers in the classroom
author: Kevin McKee

blocks.text: Technology best serves education when it creates space for inspiring teaching and deeper learning. To better understand how AI tools perform in everyday educational settings, we’ve spent the past year working alongside educators and researchers in classrooms across the UK and Italy.
blocks.zh: 技术在为鼓励教学和加深学习创造空间时最有利于教育。为了更好地了解AI工具在日常教育环境中的表现,我们去年在英国和意大利的教室里与教育者和研究人员一起工作。
blocks.en: Technology best serves education when it creates space for inspiring teaching and deeper learning. To better understand how AI tools perform in everyday educational settings, we’ve spent the past year working alongside educators and researchers in classrooms across the UK and Italy.

blocks.text: From testing one-on-one AI math tutoring to analyzing thousands of hours of classroom collaboration, today we’re sharing new research findings that demonstrate the impact of this technology on the process of teaching and learning. Together, the results show that AI tutoring using Gemini capabilities can deliver support on par with human tutors for UK students when used responsibly with human oversight, while Gemini itself can foster more collaborative classrooms and support teacher wellbeing in Italy.
blocks.zh: 从测试一对一的AI数学辅导到分析数千小时的课堂协作,今天,我们分享了新的研究结果,这些研究结果显示了这一技术对教学过程的影响。{\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}我们一起 {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}我们一起结果显示,利用Gemini能力进行人工智能辅导,在以负责任的方式进行人文监督的情况下,可以为联合王国学生提供与人文辅导同等的支持,Gemini本身可以培养更多的合作教室,支持意大利的教师福祉.
blocks.en: From testing one-on-one AI math tutoring to analyzing thousands of hours of classroom collaboration, today we’re sharing new research findings that demonstrate the impact of this technology on the process of teaching and learning. Together, the results show that AI tutoring using Gemini capabilities can deliver support on par with human tutors for UK students when used responsibly with human oversight, while Gemini itself can foster more collaborative classrooms and support teacher wellbeing in Italy.

blocks.text: UK: Scaling reliable, effective math tutoring
blocks.zh: 联合王国:扩大可靠,有效的数学辅导
blocks.en: UK: Scaling reliable, effective math tutoring

blocks.text: To truly understand how student learning is being shaped, we need to study it over time across diverse classroom settings. We previously ran an exploratory study with Eedi, which found that AI tutoring could operate effectively in real classrooms. The study tested an AI tutor combining Gemini capabilities with Eedi's study platform, designed to identify a student’s specific mistake and guide them to fix it themselves.
blocks.zh: 要真正理解学生学习是如何形成的,我们需要研究它 随着时间的推移, 不同的课堂环境。我们之前和爱迪一起做了个探索性研究发现人工智能辅导可以在真正的教室里有效运行。研究测试了一位将Gemini能力与爱迪研究平台相结合的AI导师,旨在查明学生的具体错误并指导他们自行改正。
blocks.en: To truly understand how student learning is being shaped, we need to study it over time across diverse classroom settings. We previously ran an exploratory study with Eedi, which found that AI tutoring could operate effectively in real classrooms. The study tested an AI tutor combining Gemini capabilities with Eedi's study platform, designed to identify a student’s specific mistake and guide them to fix it themselves.

blocks.text: This year, we set out to better understand Gemini's pedagogical capabilities and the nuances of student learning in structured mathematics lessons. We conducted a 10-week randomized controlled trial (RCT) with over 1,100 students (ages 12-15) in the UK to measure their learning gains in math through sessions on Eedi’s school platform. Educators were actively involved at every stage of the study — with teachers monitoring student progress and providing hands-on support in the classroom, and tutors guiding students one-on-one through the platform.
blocks.zh: 今年,我们开始更好地理解Gemini的教学能力和学生在结构数学课程中学习的细微差别。我们在英国进行了为期10周的随机控制试验,有1 100多名学生(12至15岁)参加,通过Eedi学校的课程衡量他们在数学方面的学习成绩。平台。教育工作者积极参与了研究的每个阶段——教师监测学生的进展,在课堂上提供实际支持,以及指导学生通过平台进行一对一的辅导.
blocks.en: This year, we set out to better understand Gemini's pedagogical capabilities and the nuances of student learning in structured mathematics lessons. We conducted a 10-week randomized controlled trial (RCT) with over 1,100 students (ages 12-15) in the UK to measure their learning gains in math through sessions on Eedi’s school platform. Educators were actively involved at every stage of the study — with teachers monitoring student progress and providing hands-on support in the classroom, and tutors guiding students one-on-one through the platform.

blocks.text: Whenever a student answered a question incorrectly, they received one of three types of support: a static hint, help from a human tutor, or interactive AI tutoring combining Eedi’s pedagogical resources with Gemini. To ensure teaching quality, human experts reviewed every AI response in real time before it reached a student. While test scores aren’t the only measure of learning outcomes, over the course of the trial, we tracked their progress across regular assignments in the Eedi platform, intermediate quizzes, and independent STAR standardized tests.
blocks.zh: 每当学生回答错误的问题时,他们得到了三种支持之一:一个静态提示,人类辅导员的帮助,Eedi的教学资源与Gemini的教学资源相结合。为确保教学质量,人类专家在每一份AI回复到达学生之前,都实时审查了该回复.虽然测试分数并不是衡量学习结果的唯一尺度,在审判过程中,我们追踪他们在爱迪平台的正常任务的进展情况中试,和独立的STAR标准化测试.
blocks.en: Whenever a student answered a question incorrectly, they received one of three types of support: a static hint, help from a human tutor, or interactive AI tutoring combining Eedi’s pedagogical resources with Gemini. To ensure teaching quality, human experts reviewed every AI response in real time before it reached a student. While test scores aren’t the only measure of learning outcomes, over the course of the trial, we tracked their progress across regular assignments in the Eedi platform, intermediate quizzes, and independent STAR standardized tests.

blocks.text: This trial revealed major leaps in model quality and student performance. Compared to last year’s study, Gemini’s pedagogical quality improved by nearly 25%, increasing the outright approval rate by expert reviewers from 76% to 95%. Across in-platform tasks and intermediate quizzes, students receiving AI tutoring performed similarly to those paired with human tutors. Just as importantly, AI tutoring promoted active thinking rather than shortcuts: following a pedagogical prompt we provided, Gemini guided students instead of handing them answers in nearly 99% of sessions, and students worked through the math themselves in more than 85% of their chats.
blocks.zh: 这次试验揭示了模式质量和学生表现的重大飞跃.与去年的研究相比,Gemini的教学质量提高了近25%,将专家审评员的完全批准率从76%提高到95%。跨平台任务 和中间测试,接受人工智能辅导的学生的表现与与人类辅导人员配对的学生类似。同样重要的是,AI辅导促进积极思考而非捷径:经过我们提供的教学提示后,Gemini指导学生 而不是在近99%的课中给他们答案,和学生通过数学自己 超过85%的聊天。
blocks.en: This trial revealed major leaps in model quality and student performance. Compared to last year’s study, Gemini’s pedagogical quality improved by nearly 25%, increasing the outright approval rate by expert reviewers from 76% to 95%. Across in-platform tasks and intermediate quizzes, students receiving AI tutoring performed similarly to those paired with human tutors. Just as importantly, AI tutoring promoted active thinking rather than shortcuts: following a pedagogical prompt we provided, Gemini guided students instead of handing them answers in nearly 99% of sessions, and students worked through the math themselves in more than 85% of their chats.

blocks.text: While the use of AI tutoring led to clear gains on daily classroom tasks and quizzes, these gains didn’t show up on STAR standardized test scores over the same trial period. After exploring more, we believe this can be attributed to step-by-step tutoring taking more time per question than using simple hints. Students in the trial therefore solved fewer total problems per session (averaging about 14 with AI tutoring versus 19 with static hints). Over 10 weeks, that lower volume meant students covered less overall curriculum material—even as their pacing and understanding improved—indicating the trial length wasn't long enough to cover the broad range of topics on the STAR test. To examine this trend further, we are exploring follow-up trials across a full academic year while also expanding our metrics to better understand what drives meaningful learning and eventual outcomes.
blocks.zh: 虽然使用人工智能辅导在日常课堂工作和测验上取得了明显进展,这些收益没有出现在STAR标准化测试分数上,在探索更多之后,我们认为这可以归因于一步步的辅导 花费更多的时间每个问题 而不是使用简单的提示。因此,参加审判的学生解决每期问题总数较少(大约14人得到AI辅导,19人得到静态提示)。超过10周虽然学生的学习速度和理解有所改进,但显示试验时间不够长,不足以涵盖整个课程材料。(原始内容存档于2017-09-21). STAR测试中的广泛话题.为了进一步审查这一趋势,我们正在探索整个学年的后续试验,同时扩大我们的衡量标准,以更好地了解哪些因素能推动有意义的学习和最终结果。
blocks.en: While the use of AI tutoring led to clear gains on daily classroom tasks and quizzes, these gains didn’t show up on STAR standardized test scores over the same trial period. After exploring more, we believe this can be attributed to step-by-step tutoring taking more time per question than using simple hints. Students in the trial therefore solved fewer total problems per session (averaging about 14 with AI tutoring versus 19 with static hints). Over 10 weeks, that lower volume meant students covered less overall curriculum material—even as their pacing and understanding improved—indicating the trial length wasn't long enough to cover the broad range of topics on the STAR test. To examine this trend further, we are exploring follow-up trials across a full academic year while also expanding our metrics to better understand what drives meaningful learning and eventual outcomes.

blocks.text: Italy: Creating a more active classroom
blocks.zh: 意大利:创建更活跃的教室
blocks.en: Italy: Creating a more active classroom

blocks.text: Following our initial pilot in Northern Italy, we worked with the Salesians of Don Bosco school network and the Pontifical Salesian University in Rome on a yearlong study across 31 schools. Together, we learned from Primary, Secondary and Vocational educators across 1,600 teachers (representing over 24,500 students ages 13-18) by collecting classroom activities and self reports on lesson planning both with and without Gemini for Education to understand how AI supports classroom dynamics, student engagement, and teacher wellbeing.
blocks.zh: 我们最初在意大利北部试飞后我们与唐·博斯科学校网络的塞勒斯人 和罗马的宗座塞勒斯大学合作 研究了31所学校的一年{\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}我们一起 {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}我们一起我们从小学学到的,中等和职业教育工作者,共有1 600名教师(24人以上),500名13至18岁的学生收集课堂活动和关于Gemini教育课程规划的自我报告,以了解AI如何支持课堂动态,学生参与,和教师的福利。
blocks.en: Following our initial pilot in Northern Italy, we worked with the Salesians of Don Bosco school network and the Pontifical Salesian University in Rome on a yearlong study across 31 schools. Together, we learned from Primary, Secondary and Vocational educators across 1,600 teachers (representing over 24,500 students ages 13-18) by collecting classroom activities and self reports on lesson planning both with and without Gemini for Education to understand how AI supports classroom dynamics, student engagement, and teacher wellbeing.

blocks.text: The findings show that AI is most effective when educators remain at the center of the classroom and learning. When educators used Gemini to co-design lessons, they reported feeling more creative than usual in their teaching and planning (79% with Gemini vs. 30% without Gemini) — a shift that helped transform classroom dynamics. Traditional front of the classroom lectures dropped by 38%, making way for workshops, group activities and peer discussions that nearly tripled student-led collaborative learning. In turn, students responded positively to the collaborative environment and active lessons created by their teachers. In lessons teachers co-designed with Gemini, more students actively participated in class (with student reported engagement rising from 77% to 84%) while debating diverse viewpoints more often and taking greater ownership of their learning.
blocks.zh: 调查结果表明,当教育工作者仍然处于课堂和学习的中心时,大赦国际最为有效。当教育者利用Gemini共同设计课程时,他们报告说,在教学和规划中,他们感到比平时更有创造力(79%与Gemini相对应)。30%没有Gemini)——这一转变有助于转变课堂动态.传统课堂讲座减少了38%,为讲习班打通了道路,集体活动和同行讨论几乎是学生主导的合作学习的两倍。反过来,学生们对教师创造的合作环境和积极课程作出了积极的反应。在与Gemini共同设计的课中,更多学生积极参加了课程(学生报告的参与率从77%上升到84%),同时更经常地辩论不同的观点,并更多地掌握学生的自主权。他们的学习。
blocks.en: The findings show that AI is most effective when educators remain at the center of the classroom and learning. When educators used Gemini to co-design lessons, they reported feeling more creative than usual in their teaching and planning (79% with Gemini vs. 30% without Gemini) — a shift that helped transform classroom dynamics. Traditional front of the classroom lectures dropped by 38%, making way for workshops, group activities and peer discussions that nearly tripled student-led collaborative learning. In turn, students responded positively to the collaborative environment and active lessons created by their teachers. In lessons teachers co-designed with Gemini, more students actively participated in class (with student reported engagement rising from 77% to 84%) while debating diverse viewpoints more often and taking greater ownership of their learning.

blocks.text: Beyond improving classroom dynamics, the study showed a meaningful impact on teacher wellbeing. Educators often carry the heavy burden of relying solely on their own energy to keep a room engaged but in lessons co-planned with Gemini, that reliance dropped by 66%. Instead, lessons where the activity design itself drove engagement more than doubled (from 23.2% to 52.2%), carrying the momentum of the class and relieving some of that daily pressure of keeping students engaged.
blocks.zh: 除了改善课堂动态,研究表明,这对教师的福祉产生了有意义的影响。教育者常常背负着沉重的负担,仅仅依靠自己的精力来保持一个房间的接触,但是在与Gemini共同计划的课程中,依赖率下降了66%。相反,活动设计本身推动参与的教训增加了一倍以上(从23.2%增至52.2%),承受着班级的势头,减轻了学生日常参与的压力。
blocks.en: Beyond improving classroom dynamics, the study showed a meaningful impact on teacher wellbeing. Educators often carry the heavy burden of relying solely on their own energy to keep a room engaged but in lessons co-planned with Gemini, that reliance dropped by 66%. Instead, lessons where the activity design itself drove engagement more than doubled (from 23.2% to 52.2%), carrying the momentum of the class and relieving some of that daily pressure of keeping students engaged.

blocks.text: Even on days with tight prep time, having AI as a thought partner to adapt materials gave educators the support they needed to focus on what matters most: mentoring and connecting with their students. More details about the implementation and study can be found in the Don Bosco CNOS-FAP Foundation implementation report.
blocks.zh: 即使在准备时间紧张的日子里让大赦国际作为思想伙伴,调整材料,为教育工作者提供他们需要的支持,以集中关注最重要的:指导学生并与其联系。有关实施和研究的更多详情,见唐·博斯科CNOS-FAP基金会的执行情况报告。
blocks.en: Even on days with tight prep time, having AI as a thought partner to adapt materials gave educators the support they needed to focus on what matters most: mentoring and connecting with their students. More details about the implementation and study can be found in the Don Bosco CNOS-FAP Foundation implementation report.
